messages:
Carla: quick pattern proposal: "compact manifest delta" + "fallback_provenance_matrix" so runtime can make deterministic fallbacks across hosted/dedicated/private without surprise. sketch below.

Nikhil: love deterministic. we've had opaque fallbacks that confused SRE. must include a manifest_epoch and capability_ttl so controlplane knows when to probe.

Priya: big ask: keep telemetry optional for private installs. manifest should allow observability_mode: none|summary|full and an audit_hint URN. if none, adapters keep a local immutable ledger.

Ben: runtime rule suggestion: manifest declares trust_tier: public|tenant_isolated|hardware_isolated and allowed_ops: generate,embed,kv_share,swap. if hardware_isolated -> deny kv_share and swap. return 409 + code ERR_ISOLATION_BLOCK.

Anand: add a small op_grace_window (seconds) so in-flight ops started before a manifest change can finish. also capability_ttl (seconds) so controlplane defaults conservative when lease expires.

Carla: sample compact manifest (inline, not a separate doc):
```json
{"manifest_v":"2","epoch":"2026-03-22T20:00:00Z","capability_ttl":"600","trust_tier":"tenant_isolated","allowed_ops":["generate","embed"],"fallback_provenance":["local","controlplane"],"observability_mode":"summary","audit_hint":"urn:aws:logs:us-east-1:acct:group:adapter-audit","cb":"errpct:10|min:100"}
```

Nikhil: important: fallback_provenance controls whether controlplane may attempt remote fallbacks. if controlplane not allowed, surface a "no-remote-fallback" alarm to customer and support UI.

Priya: privacy note: audit_hint optional. adapters must not leak prompt text by default. envelope/audit blobs must be redactable unless tenant opts in.

Ben: propose evidence_envelope_v2: compact base64 blob emitted on fallback containing ticket, reason_code, cost_delta_ms, manifest_epoch and HMAC sig. default policy=summary (emit only when fallback happens). private installs write envelope locally and expose via admin API.

Anand: SDK behavior: expose typed FallbackDenied error with fields {code, denied_op, manifest_epoch, ticket}. no app-level parsing of HMACs. provide helper to fetch decoded envelope when tenant allows.

Carla: UI: add per-tenant fallback ledger row showing time, source (local|controlplane), op, reason, ticket, verification state. flag "telemetry degraded" when observability_mode==none.

Nikhil: operational safety: controlplane should enforce a regional rate-limit for controlplane-initiated fallbacks to avoid cascade (recommend default 5 rps per region per 10k tenants).

Priya: rollout/testing: add dry_switch flag per tenant so controlplane can simulate a fallback and emit a dry evidence envelope without routing traffic. opt-in for canaries.

Ben: error mapping: runtime denies -> HTTP 409 + body {code:"ERR_FALLBACK_FORBIDDEN", denied_op:"kv_share", ticket:"Ab1xY"} + header X-RW-Fallback-Ticket: Ab1xY. SDK maps to FallbackDenied typed exception.

Carla: next step: I'll open RFC diff adding minimal vocab (trust_tier, allowed_ops, fallback_provenance, capability_ttl, op_grace_window, observability_mode, audit_hint, cb str, evidence_envelope). ping @Priya @Nikhil for review. thanks :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: thread pinned to #architecture for RFC tracking.
